findings.title: Repository-bound evidence identity still prevents semantic persistence
findings.reproduction: Run the b4a83f8 cascade with repo_root, all source snapshots, full semantic validation, and a temporary backlog write. T03's preserved evidence manifests retain branch codex/w1-windows-local-runtime while the demoted task branch is null, so both evidence attachments fail branch-to-task identity validation.
findings.requiredResolution: Preserve the historical branch projection or add an equally strict historical identity model, and make the regression test use repo_root plus a real temporary persistence boundary.

closures.resolution: The traversal now follows both task dependencies and every candidate task's slice.depends_on edges; the focused slice-level test passed independently.
